description: Player 2 deck for specs 30, 31 (player 1 side is 31-spells-a) and 32: 08-do-nothing-b card list. Every card costs 3 or more and none has a Cast-on-draw, a Quickdraw, a hand trigger or a Trap, so player 2 does nothing on the turns these specs pass through and the board and both heroes move only through player 1 plays.
